key.name: enabled-widgets
key.description: List of enabled widget IDs to display on the desktop

key.name: widget-positions
key.description: JSON object storing coordinates (x, y) for each widget

key.name: desktop-layer
key.description: Where widgets are attached: 'desktop' (behind windows) or 'top' (above windows)

key.name: glass-opacity
key.description: Liquid glass tint strength (0.15 to 0.95). Lower values show more of the blurred wallpaper.

key.name: glass-appearance
key.description: Glass theme: 'system', 'dark', or 'light'. Liquid glass is kept in all modes.

key.name: widget-sizes
key.description: JSON object storing width and height for each resized widget

key.name: weather-city
key.description: City name for weather or 'Auto' for geolocation

key.name: notes-content
key.default: 'Desktop Notes\n• Click here to edit\n• Press Esc or unfocus to save'
key.description: Persisted text inside the desktop notes widget

key.name: dock-pinned-apps
key.description: JSON array of .desktop file IDs pinned to the App Container Dock widget
